process.label: C - Clarity
process.text: We find the real problem. Who the business is, what isn't working in its branding, and what the brand needs to say before anyone designs anything.

process.label: L - Logic
process.text: We build the strategy. Core values and positioning become the rules every design decision has to follow, so the brand has a reason behind each choice.

process.label: E - Execution
process.text: We design the identity. Concepts are tested and refined until one direction is clearly the strongest, then developed into the final mark and palette.

process.label: A - Asset creation
process.text: We produce the full system: logo variants, colour, typography, tone of voice and guidelines, plus the applications the business actually needs.

process.label: R - Results
process.text: We check the brand is doing its job. The aim is a identity people recognise at a glance and that carries the same authority as the business behind it.

projects.title: SS Security Co
projects.caption: New branding project - 2026, logo design
projects.summary: SS Security Co avoided the padlock cliché for a mark built on strength, warmth, and recognition.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: A Manchester security startup with nationwide corporate and residential clients and no branding yet. In an industry full of padlocks and shields, the mark had to carry the same authority as the service.

case.label: Logic
case.text: The identity was built on six principles: strength, approachability, simplicity, legibility, professionalism, and national reach. A first concept, two clashing S's, read as busy, so the approved direction became a doubled SS where straight lines and curves work together.

case.label: Execution
case.text: Straight lines communicate strength and curves communicate approachability. Repeating the letterform keeps the mark legible whether it sits small on a laptop or large on a jacket. The palette is a deep blue pulled toward purple for trust.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: Logo construction and clear-space guidelines, applied across business cards, laptop decals, and uniform embroidery.

case.label: Results
case.text: The branding and the expertise now work together. The identity carries the same authority the company already had in the industry.

projects.title: Coffee By The Corner
projects.caption: New branding project - 2026, brand identity
projects.summary: Coffee By The Corner needed a brand as warm and welcoming as the space itself.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: A small independent coffee shop serving breakfast, lunch, and snacks, and hosting local events. Its plain, cold, white branding didn't match the warmth people felt the moment they walked in.

case.label: Logic
case.text: The interior became the brief. Cosy corners and a sense of belonging were strategic, so the brand had to earn the warmth the shop already delivered.

case.label: Execution
case.text: The logo is a rectangle with two rounded corners and two sharp ones, a direct nod to the name. Deep browns, terracotta, and cream replaced the white.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: A simple identity built around the logo mark and palette, designed to feel calm, grounded, and inviting.

case.label: Results
case.text: The brand now matches the shop. It communicates warmth, friendliness, and community before a word is read.

projects.title: Better UK
projects.caption: New branding project - 2026, brand identity
projects.summary: Better UK needed a clearer identity that showed the scale, inclusivity, and community impact behind its health and wellbeing work.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: A community-first organisation helping people of all ages lead healthier lives across the UK. Its visual identity had become outdated and scattered, so members couldn't see what the brand offered.

case.label: Logic
case.text: Five core values shaped every decision: community, accessibility, health and wellbeing, positivity, and reliability.

case.label: Execution
case.text: The logo has three parts: a shield for safety and reliability, two interlocking lines for connection, and a simplified person at the centre for the people the brand serves.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: Clean, legible typography and balanced layouts, with an energetic but approachable visual style across digital and print.

case.label: Results
case.text: A unified presence across digital and physical platforms. Audiences now understand what Better UK stands for: community, wellbeing, and positive change.

projects.title: Mevo Banking
projects.caption: New branding project - 2025, brand identity
projects.summary: Mevo makes banking simple and reliable. They needed a brand that showed speed, trust, and forward momentum.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: Mevo's fintech product was fast and reliable, but its branding didn't say so. Early ideas blended into competitors like Monzo, Revolut, and Starling, and nothing felt original.

case.label: Logic
case.text: Strategy sessions uncovered four values: simplicity, reliability, progress, and connection. The audience was risk-takers, doers, and small business owners.

case.label: Execution
case.text: The breakthrough came from movement: money moves, people move, waves move. Two waves form an M, paired with fluid forms, structured layouts, and deep blues for stability.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: The M logo, a visual identity of fluid forms and structured layouts, and a tone that is calm yet confident.

case.label: Results
case.text: The brand reflects who Mevo really is. It resonates with its audience and sets Mevo apart in a crowded fintech market.

projects.title: Royal Advisors
projects.caption: New branding project - 2025, brand identity
projects.summary: Royal Advisors helps founders build and grow. They needed a brand as confident and human as they are.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: A business consultancy for founders, in a space full of cold blues, stiff layouts, and corporate language. The brand needed personality, and it needed to be done in two weeks.

case.label: Logic
case.text: A brand strategy workshop set three values: honest, clear, and precise. The positioning: a firm that treats every business as personally as its owner does.

case.label: Execution
case.text: A custom geometric R logomark, a palette of emerald, rich gold, royal purple, and ivory, and a gradient aura treatment. Set in Man Rope, with the slogan Launch. Grow. Succeed.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: Three logo variants, a full colour palette, a tone of voice, and a brand guidelines system built to scale.

case.label: Results
case.text: A brand that matches who they are, delivered in two weeks. The project also grew into a complete website, designed and built in four hours.

projects.title: Veloria Home
projects.caption: New branding project - 2026, brand identity
projects.summary: Veloria Home is a warm, modern homeware brand turning everyday essentials into inviting comfort.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: The identity was a plain black-and-white logo on a shopping bag. It lacked personality and any connection to the home, so it didn't reflect the warmth of the products.

case.label: Logic
case.text: Four values guided the work: warmth and comfort, modern elegance, thoughtful quality, and elevated simplicity.

case.label: Execution
case.text: A simplified home outline frames a V cut into a rounded triangle. At the centre, a pillow icon doubles as a top-down bed, highlighting the main product categories.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: A stacked logo and wordmark, set in Jazmin Alt and Tilt Neon, with a palette of gold, pine green, sage, and off-white.

case.label: Results
case.text: The brand moved from lifeless to engaging. It feels grounded and inviting, and it builds trust and recognition in home retail.

projects.title: PinkLime
projects.caption: New branding project - 2025, brand identity
projects.summary: A complete brand redesign for a Manchester women-led web design agency, keeping its signature pink and modernising the logo and visuals.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: Despite strong client work, the logo had been tweaked into an outdated state, and the website and visuals didn't show the agency's professionalism or personality.

case.label: Logic
case.text: Keep the signature pink, show personality, signal credibility, and stay serious without being corporate: human, but not soft.

case.label: Execution
case.text: A lime with a slice replaced by a cursor. Rounded, calm, modern, and playful.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: Updated colours, typography, and graphics aligned with a playful, professional personality.

case.label: Results
case.text: Clients now see a professional, playful, and human agency. The brand speaks their value before the first conversation.

projects.title: Rapid Transit
projects.caption: New branding project - 2024, brand identity
projects.summary: Premium ride-hailing for fast, efficient business travel.

case.label: Clarity
case.text: A premium ride-hailing service for business professionals, between taxis and chauffeurs. Most competitors are either cheap and fast or premium and slow.

case.label: Logic
case.text: Three principles: speed, efficiency, and luxury. Everything had to communicate movement and control, not chaos.

case.label: Execution
case.text: The logo merges an R and a T. An arrow at the centre of the R signals forward motion, and neon green adds energy against darker, refined tones.

case.label: Asset creation
case.text: The logo mark and a colour palette that balances fast energy with controlled luxury.

case.label: Results
case.text: A service built for people who move differently. The brand communicates fast, efficient travel with a high-end finish.
